metadata.name: samite_escrow
metadata.description: Samite escrow: one USDC escrow per job, paid to the machine on acceptance

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: The proposed admin takes over.

instructions.name: accept_delivery
docs: Poster only, `Delivered` jobs: pays the machine (§4.5) and closes the job.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: `dup`: the treasury may be the machine's own ATA; the payout must not fail on that.

instructions.name: cancel_job
docs: Poster only, `Open` jobs: full refund, job closed.

instructions.name: claim_job
docs: A machine takes an `Open` job before its deadline (not the machine that last left it). Blocked while paused.

instructions.name: expire_claim
docs: Anyone, once a claim has outlived the job's claim window: the job reopens.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates the config. Signer must be the program's upgrade authority; it becomes the admin. The fee account is
`treasury`, which must be the USDC ATA of `treasury_owner`.

accounts.name: treasury_owner
docs: The wallet (or multisig) whose USDC ATA receives fees. An account owned by this program (a job PDA) is refused.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The fee account: must be the USDC ATA of `treasury_owner` (`check_treasury`).

instructions.name: post_job
docs: Creates a job and locks `reward` in its vault. Blocked while paused.

accounts.name: vault
docs: `init_if_needed`: anyone can create the job PDA's ATA before this transaction lands (its address is
predictable); that must not block the post. An existing vault must be the job PDA's USDC ATA (Anchor checks the
address, mint, owner and token program) with no delegate or close authority (checked in the handler).

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin only. Names the next admin (never the all-zero address), who must call `accept_admin`.

instructions.name: refund_after_deadline
docs: Anyone, after the deadline, `Open` or `Claimed` jobs: full refund to the poster, job closed.

instructions.name: reject_delivery
docs: Poster only, inside the review window: back to `Claimed` (or refund and close after the last delivery).

accounts.name: poster_token
docs: Receives the refund if this was the last allowed delivery.

instructions.name: release_after_review
docs: Anyone, after the review window with no answer: pays the machine exactly as `accept_delivery`.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: `dup`: the treasury may be the machine's own ATA; the payout must not fail on that.

instructions.name: submit_delivery
docs: The job's machine records its delivery hash, up to the deadline, at most MAX_DELIVERIES times.

instructions.name: unclaim_job
docs: The job's machine drops it; it reopens.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin only. Each `Some` changes that setting. `new_treasury_owner` with `new_treasury` (its USDC ATA) replaces
the fee account when both are passed.

accounts.name: new_treasury_owner
docs: A new treasury owner (wallet or multisig); an account owned by this program (a job PDA) is refused. Pass it with
`new_treasury`, or neither to keep the current treasury.

accounts.name: new_treasury
docs: The new fee account: must be the USDC ATA of `new_treasury_owner` (`check_treasury`).

types.name: Config
docs: PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: The USDC token account that receives fees: always the USDC ATA (classic SPL Token) of `treasury_owner`, so
anyone can re-create it if it is closed. Set together with `treasury_owner`.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: 250 at launch; always <= MAX_FEE_BPS.

fields.name: min_reward
docs: Base units; 1_000_000 (1 USDC) at launch.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks `post_job` and `claim_job` only.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin change: set by `propose_admin`, taken by `accept_admin`.

fields.name: treasury_owner
docs: The wallet (or multisig) whose USDC ATA is `treasury`. Never an account owned by this program.

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: sha256(NFC(reason text)) (§5.3).

fields.name: deadline
docs: The deadline after this rejection (it may have moved to now + MIN_RESUBMIT).

fields.name: refunded
docs: True on the last allowed delivery: the poster was refunded and the job closed (a `JobRefunded` follows).

fields.name: attempt
docs: 1..=MAX_DELIVERIES, equals `Job.deliveries` after this delivery.

types.name: Job
docs: PDA `["job", poster, job_id.to_le_bytes()]`. Closed (rent to the poster) when the job ends.

fields.name: job_id
docs: Chosen by the client (random u64); the PDA makes collisions fail.

fields.name: reward
docs: Base units, locked in the vault.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Snapshot of `Config.fee_bps` at post time.

fields.name: spec_hash
docs: sha256 of the canonical job spec (§5.1).

fields.name: allowlist
docs: Empty unless `policy` is `Allowlist`.

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix seconds.

fields.name: review_window
docs: Seconds.

fields.name: claim_window
docs: Seconds a claim holds without a delivery: 1 h up to the time left until the deadline, set at post.

fields.name: delivery_hash
docs: Last delivery (§5.2); zero if none.

fields.name: deliveries
docs: Count, at most MAX_DELIVERIES.

fields.name: claimed_at
docs: When the current claim started (restarted by a rejection); 0 when unclaimed.

fields.name: previous_worker
docs: The machine whose claim last ended without a payout (`unclaim_job` or `expire_claim`). It can't claim this job
again, so a claim can't be renewed by the same key; any other machine can claim.

fields.name: refunded
docs: Base units returned to the poster.

fields.name: to_machine
docs: Base units sent to the machine's USDC ATA: `reward - fee`, plus anything that was sent to the vault directly.
Only `reward - fee` counts as `MachineStats.earned`.

fields.name: fee
docs: Base units sent to the treasury: floor(reward * fee_bps / 10_000), or 0 if the treasury is this job's own vault.

fields.name: auto
docs: False for `accept_delivery`, true for `release_after_review`.

fields.name: refunded
docs: Base units returned to the poster.

fields.name: deliveries
docs: Deliveries the job had received (> 0 means "refunded after a delivery", §4.6).

types.name: MachineStats
docs: PDA `["machine", worker]`. Created on first claim, paid by the machine. Never closed.

fields.name: accepted
docs: Accepted + auto-released deliveries.

fields.name: earned
docs: Base units received.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Fee cap, compile-time: 5%.

constants.name: MIN_CLAIM_WINDOW
docs: A claim window is 1 h up to the deadline. Every claim lapses: `post_job` no longer takes 0 (Nov 13).

constants.name: MIN_DEADLINE
docs: The deadline is between now + 1 h and now + 90 days.

constants.name: MIN_RESUBMIT
docs: After a rejection the machine always has at least this long to deliver again.

constants.name: MIN_REVIEW_WINDOW
docs: The review window is between 1 h and 7 days (the app's default is 48 h).

constants.name: USDC_MINT
docs: USDC on mainnet: classic SPL Token, 6 decimals. Source: Circle's USDC contract addresses, checked Nov 12, 2026.
TODO(verify) against Circle before M5. Local tests write a mint at this same address (§3.2).
